intro: [thoughtful] Diez huecos, diez palabras. ¿Hasta dónde llegas?

verdict: Llegar a la tres es nivel básico; a la siete, intermedio; y a la diez, experto.

La reunión se celebrará el viernes.

english_phrases: We were at home last night.
If I were you, I'd go.

full_script: [thoughtful] Diez huecos, diez palabras. ¿Hasta dónde llegas? I am from Colombia. They are my friends. It was cold yesterday. Ahora, nivel intermedio. We were at home last night. Are you hungry? I will be 30 next month. The keys have been found. Y ahora, nivel experto. If I were you, I'd go. The meeting is being held on Friday. You are to to arrive on time. Llegar a la tres es nivel básico; a la siete, intermedio; y a la diez, experto. [happy] ¿Cuántas acertaste? Déjame tu número abajo.
